question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Final query with clean output
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT MAX(race_id) as last_race_id, year
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
final_driver_standings AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points, r.year
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON ds.race_id = lry.last_race_id
),
final_constructor_standings AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points, r.year
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON cs.race_id = lry.last_race_id
),
best_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, constructor_ref, driver_id, driver_ref
    FROM team_driver_ranks
    WHERE team_driver_rank::VARCHAR = '1'
)
SELECT c.name as constructor, bd.year, 
       ROUND(fcs.constructor_points + fds.driver_points, 1) as combined_points
FROM best_drivers bd
JOIN final_driver_standings fds ON bd.driver_id = fds.driver_id AND bd.year = fds.year
JOIN final_constructor_standings fcs ON bd.constructor_id = fcs.constructor_id AND bd.year = fcs.year
JOIN constructors c ON bd.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build the full query: best driver points + constructor points per constructor/year
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT MAX(race_id) as last_race_id, year
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
final_driver_standings AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points, ds.position as driver_position, r.year
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON ds.race_id = lry.last_race_id
),
final_constructor_standings AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points, cs.position as constructor_position, r.year
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON cs.race_id = lry.last_race_id
),
best_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, constructor_ref, driver_id, driver_ref
    FROM team_driver_ranks

FROM best_drivers bd
JOIN final_driver_standings fds ON bd.driver_id = fds.driver_id AND bd.year = fds.year
JOIN final_constructor_standings fcs ON bd.constructor_id = fcs.constructor_id AND bd.year = fcs.year

best_drivers AS (
